gate_order: 40 rounds of six disjoint opaque pairs; reverse each pair orientation on odd rounds
architectures: chain 0..11, plus edge 11--0 for ring; physical relabeling is a fixed seeded permutation
edge_calibration: edge i--i+1 has weight 2.8 for even i and 0.45 for odd i; ring closing edge has weight 0.45
fixed_initial: initial[logical] equals the physical relabel permutation; all relocation is paid in witness SWAPs
witness_construction: For each logical pair, Dijkstra search on its ordered pair of physical positions minimizes calibrated SWAP work until the pair occupies any 0.45-weight edge. Replay swaps tracking all tokens, then emit all original gate IDs for that pair in increasing order. Different pairs have disjoint logical wires, permitting this batching.
scope: Supplementary probes are reported separately from the pre-frozen 36-case matched suite.
